name: DLSS 5 Swapper
one_liner: Scans your game library and installs or restores DLSS 5 per game.

text.why: Swapping DLSS files by hand is an easy way to lose originals, and which games it works in is trial and error. DLSS 5 Swapper scans Steam, Epic, GOG and Game Pass folders, manages install, restore and backup per game, and routes games without DLSS through Feeder and old APIs through dgVoodoo. An F8 overlay moves the sliders in-game, and a community page shows reports from people with your card. Free, MIT, Windows 10/11 only; for anti-cheat games it warns of crashes or bans.
text.take: The point is less the install than the backup, restore and community reports gathered on one screen.
build: A personal routine that applies and reverts one setting across a library
A community report of results per game and graphics card
An experiment putting neural rendering on old DX9 and emulator titles

who.situation: wants DLSS 5 across several games on an RTX card
wants to upscale old console titles

start.text: Download the Windows installer or the portable build from the latest release
Verify the checksum with SHA256SUMS.txt on the same page
The Feeder route needs Visual C++ runtimes (x64, plus x86 for 32-bit games)

caveat: Anti-cheat games risk crashes or bans; the app warns but never bypasses
The bundled OptiScaler model runs only on RTX 50-series cards
No Linux binaries; Proton is experimental community source only

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
